summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests preventive treatments (Prophylaxis A, B, C and D) for taste changes (dysgeusia) caused by talquetamab in relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma. Talquetamab is given under the skin, and Prophylaxis A, B and C are taken by mouth starting 7 days before talquetamab, while Prophylaxis D is applied topically starting 1 day before. Prophylaxis may continue for up to 12 months, and longer at the physician's discretion, and the study also describes taste changes with ramantamig, given under the skin as one step-up dose followed by a treatment dose. The record states the aim is to see whether these preventive treatments reduce the occurrence, severity and duration of taste changes, but no formal main outcome measure is listed.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa tratamientos preventivos (profilaxis A, B, C y D) para los cambios en el gusto (disgeusia) causados por talquetamab en mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario. Talquetamab se administra debajo de la piel, y las profilaxis A, B y C se toman por vía oral comenzando 7 días antes de talquetamab, mientras que la profilaxis D se aplica por vía tópica comenzando 1 día antes. La profilaxis puede continuar hasta 12 meses, y más tiempo a criterio del médico, y el estudio también describe los cambios en el gusto con ramantamig, que se administra debajo de la piel como una dosis inicial escalonada seguida de la dosis de tratamiento. El registro indica que el objetivo es ver si estos tratamientos preventivos reducen la aparición, la gravedad y la duración de los cambios en el gusto, pero no se incluye una medida de resultado principal formal.
who_for: Multiple myeloma that has come back or stopped responding
Previously treated with a proteasome inhibitor, an immunomodulatory drug, and an anti-CD38 antibody
Documented disease progression after the last treatment regimen
ECOG performance status 0 or 1; 2 or 3 only if due to stable limits not related to myeloma
Age 18 years or older and willing to follow protocol lifestyle restrictions
not_for: Life-threatening allergy or intolerance to study drugs or their excipients
Stroke, transient ischemic attack, or seizure within 6 months before screening
Serious heart events or NYHA class III or IV heart failure within 6 months before first dose
Major surgery or significant trauma within 2 weeks, or planned major surgery
Severe dysgeusia at screening, or oral conditions such as active infections or prior mouth cancer
